newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Finnish Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen would meet Commission President Jacques Santer in the evening. He said Prime Minister Lipponen would meet reporters in the Breydel's VIP corner at 1815/1615 GMT.
Van der Pas said the Commission would meet on Tuesday and that Commissioner Anita Gradin would hold a news conference on the fight against fraud at 1215/1015 GMT.

In answer to a question spokeswoman Barbara Nolan said the Britain's sign-up and integration to the European Union's social chapter would take place in the framework of the inter-governmental conference. She said the Commission's legal services were currently examining the technical implications of UK Foreign Secretary Robin Cook's announcement on Sunday that Britain would sign the social chapter.

Nolan said the social legislations currently in the pipeline were proposals on sharing the burden of proof in sex discrimination cases, rights for part-time workers, sexual harassment at work, and imminently a proposal on information and consultation at national level.

Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi said the UK's decision to reduce its VAT rates on domestic fuel went against the spirit of the EU directive on harmonisation of VAT rates at 15 percent and against the good functioning of the internal market. Asked if the Commission's approval was needed to make such a cut she said that the legal moment for the Commission to interfere would be afterwards, as guardian of the EU legislation.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/386: Commission initiates detailed investigation into the creation of a joint venture between the Coca-Cola company and Carlsberg.
- IP/97/387: 10 May 1997: open day at the European Parliament, the Council of the European Union, the European Commission, the Economic and Social Committee and th Committe of the Regions.
- Speech/97/107: Speech by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan on "creating a partnership of equals".
